scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml
scripts.release: npm --prefix frontend run build && cargo build --release --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run release && systemctl --user restart code-map
scripts.check: npm --prefix frontend run build && cargo fmt --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml
